issuer: the Amt für Strassenverkehr (Office of Road Traffic)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on gesetze.li, the Government's consolidated law. The Verkehrszulassungsverordnung (VZV) of 1 August 1978, LGBl. 1978 Nr. 20, as in force 1 July 2026: art. 6(1)(e), the minimum age to drive categories B and BE is 17; art. 24(1), the licence is issued after the practical test is passed; art. 24(2), licences of all categories are issued for 15 years from the last eye test, or until the next medical check where one is due (art. 27). Art. 6(2) to (2b), for apprentices in certain trades, has the B test taken at most six months before 18 and the licence issued from 18; that is read as the apprentices' rule, so 17, the general minimum age, is held: a reading to check. The Amt für Strassenverkehr's fee ordinance (LGBl. 2004 Nr. 258, as in force 1 January 2026), item 2.2: a licence of every category but F, G and M, CHF 60, held (the learner's licence and the tests aren't). No identity card is held (the identity card is the ids engine's); converting an EU or Swiss licence costs CHF 60 (item 2.3), but the countries exchanged weren't read into a list.
